const int MOD = 998244353;
const long long mask = (1LL << 31) - 1;

long long modh(long long a, long long M, int h, int mod) {
    long long r = a - ((M * (a & mask) >> 31) + M * (a >> 31) >> (h - 31)) * mod;
    return r < mod ? r : r - mod;
}

long long pow_mod(long long a, long long n, long long mod) {
    long long ret = 1;
    int x = 63 - __builtin_clzll(n);
    for (; x >= 0; x--) {
        ret = ret * ret % mod;
        if (n << (63 - x) < 0)
            ret = ret * a % mod;
    }
    return ret;
}

long long invl(long long a, long long mod) {
    long long b = mod;
    long long p = 1, q = 0;
    while (b > 0) {
        long long c = a / b;
        long long d;
        d = a;
        a = b;
        b = d % b;
        d = p;
        p = q;
        q = d - c * q;
    }
    return p < 0 ? p + mod : p;
}

vector<long long> nttmb(vector<long long> src, int n, bool inverse, int P, int g) {
    vector<long long> dst = src;
    dst.resize(n, 0);

    int h = __builtin_ctz(n);
    long long K = (long long)__builtin_clzll((unsigned long long)P) ? (1LL << (63 - __builtin_clzll((unsigned long long)P))) : 1;
    if (K == 0) K = 1;
    K = K << 1;
    int H = __builtin_ctzll(K) * 2;
    long long M = K * K / P;

    vector<int> wws(1 << (h - 1), 0);
    long long dw = inverse ? pow_mod(g, P - 1 - (P - 1) / n, P) : pow_mod(g, (P - 1) / n, P);
    long long w = (1LL << 32) % P;
    for (int k = 0; k < (1 << (h - 1)); k++) {
        wws[k] = (int)w;
        w = modh(w * dw, M, H, P);
    }
    long long J = invl(P, 1LL << 32);
    for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << i); j++) {
            for (int k = 0, s = j << (h - i), t = s | (1 << (h - i - 1)); k < (1 << (h - i - 1)); k++, s++, t++) {
                long long u = (dst[s] - dst[t] + 2 * P) * wws[k];
                dst[s] += dst[t];
                if (dst[s] >= 2 * P) dst[s] -= 2 * P;
                long long Q = ((u << 32) * J) >> 32;
                dst[t] = (u >> 32) - (Q * P >> 32) + P;
            }
        }
        if (i < h - 1) {
            for (int k = 0; k < (1 << (h - i - 2)); k++) 
                wws[k] = wws[k * 2];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (dst[i] >= P) dst[i] -= P;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int rev = __builtin_ctz(i) ? 0 : (32 - __builtin_clz(i));
        rev = __builtin_bswap32(i) >> (32 - h);
        if (i < rev) {
            long long d = dst[i];
            dst[i] = dst[rev];
            dst[rev] = d;
        }
    }

    if (inverse) {
        long long in = invl(n, P);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) 
            dst[i] = modh(dst[i] * in, M, H, P);
    }

    return dst;
}

vector<long long> convoluteSimply(vector<long long> a, vector<long long> b, int P, int g) {
    int m = max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(max((int)a.size(), (int)b.size()) - 1) + 1));
    vector<long long> fa = nttmb(a, m, false, P, g);
    vector<long long> fb = (a == b) ? fa : nttmb(b, m, false, P, g);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        fa[i] = fa[i] * fb[i] % P;
    }
    return nttmb(fa, m, true, P, g);
}

class LuckyTickets {
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, vector<string>& input, int& index, ostream& out) {
        int N = stoi(input[index++]);
        int k = stoi(input[index++]);
        vector<long long> dig(11, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int val = stoi(input[index++]);
            dig[10 - val] = 1;
        }
        int power = N / 2;
        vector<long long> res = {1};
        while (power > 0) {
            if (power & 1) {
                res = convoluteSimply(res, dig, MOD, 3);
            }
            dig = convoluteSimply(dig, dig, MOD, 3);
            power >>= 1;
        }
        long long output = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < res.size(); i++) {
            output += res[i] * res[i];
            output %= MOD;
        }
        out << output << endl;
    }
};

class InputReader {
public:
    vector<string> lines;
    int index;

    InputReader(vector<string>& input) : lines(input), index(0) {}

    string next() {
        while (index >= lines.size()) {
            return "";
        }
        string line = lines[index++];
        istringstream iss(line);
        vector<string> tokens;
        string token;
        while (iss >> token) {
            tokens.push_back(token);
        }
        if (!tokens.empty()) {
            return tokens[0];
        }
        return "";
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
};

    InputReader in(input);
    LuckyTickets solver;
    solver.solve(1, input, in.index, cout);
    
    return 0;
}
